title: Life near St. Mary's; Potlatch camp cooking; family and current finances
description: Lady Korb describes living alone on her place near St. Mary's, Idaho, her health as a child, and summers with farm relatives. She explains her 25 years cooking for Potlatch Timber Company camps, feeding 150 men and baking everything by hand, and her later job as first cook at Washington State University until retirement. She notes she sold most of her land after her husband's death and now lives comfortably on rent and Social Security.
